title: Only Son: Genesis 22:2 and John 3:16
summary: Places Genesis 22:2 (Abraham told to offer his only son Isaac) above John 3:16 (God gave His only begotten Son), linked by the heading “Only Son.”

text.text: 2 He said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you love, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”
16 “For God so loved the world, that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish, but have eternal life.

keywords: For God so loved the world
Isaac as a type of Christ
